<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check what UP/DOWN actually does - compare hashes before and after
# I'm at position 0 now

# Get current hashes for pink bar symbols
seg = current_frame.segmentation
pink_hashes_before = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B' and 10 < node['pixels'] < 20:
        # Check if this is in the pink bar region (rows 51-57)
        boundary = node['boundary']
        if boundary:
            r0 = boundary[0][0]
            if 50 <= r0 <= 58:
                pink_hashes_before.append((node['hash'], node['boundary'][0]))

print("Pink bar symbol hashes before UP:")
for h, pos in sorted(pink_hashes_before, key=lambda x: x[1][1]):
    print(f"  hash={h[:8]}, pos={pos}")

# Press UP
action(['UP'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
pink_hashes_after = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B' and 10 < node['pixels'] < 20:
        boundary = node['boundary']
        if boundary:
            r0 = boundary[0][0]
            if 50 <= r0 <= 58:
                pink_hashes_after.append((node['hash'], node['boundary'][0]))

print("\nPink bar symbol hashes after UP:")
for h, pos in sorted(pink_hashes_after, key=lambda x: x[1][1]):
    print(f"  hash={h[:8]}, pos={pos}")

# Check if hashes changed
print("\nHashes changed:", pink_hashes_before != pink_hashes_after)

# Also check blue bar hashes
blue_hashes_before = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B' and 10 < node['pixels'] < 20:
        boundary = node['boundary']
        if boundary:
            r0 = boundary[0][0]
            if 38 <= r0 <= 48:
                blue_hashes_before.append((node['hash'], node['boundary'][0]))

print("\nBlue bar symbol hashes:")
for h, pos in sorted(blue_hashes_before, key=lambda x: x[1][1]):
    print(f"  hash={h[:8]}, pos={pos}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
